ThaiMarketFinds TikTok Content Workflow
1. Start With TikTok
Navigate to Creator Search Insights.
2. Find a Topic
Use keywords connected to ThaiMarketFinds, including:
Thai products
Thailand shopping
Thai skincare
Thailand markets
Thai food
Thailand travel
Thai products to resell
Things to buy in Thailand
3. Identify Opportunities
Look for subjects with high search interest or a Content Gap.
Select a topic that works for ThaiMarketFinds.
4. Work in AI Canvas
Bring the topic you selected into AI Canvas.
Enter a description of what you want it to create.
For example:
“Generate a TikTok post about 5 Thai skincare products people should know about.”
Let AI Canvas develop the post concept, organization, and content.
5. Build the Post
Adapt the idea to your TikTok format:
Slideshow
Use product photos
Place text on each slide
Include quick facts
Faceless video
Use shopping footage
Add product clips
Include market footage
Use text overlays
Talking video
Describe the topic
Provide recommendations
Answer the question
6. Apply Information From Creator Search Insights
Creator Search Insights already supplies items such as:
Recommended keywords
Search terms
Hashtags
Caption suggestions
Search-related information
Whenever appropriate, use those directly rather than developing a separate hashtag and caption strategy.
7. Include Your ThaiMarketFinds Personality
Make sure the content offers more than information alone.
Add elements such as:
Your recommendation
Product opinions
Thailand shopping tips
Sourcing information
Restaurant recommendations
Places to stay
Nearby places to visit
Tips for people traveling to Thailand
8. Finish With a CTA
End with a prompt that encourages people to engage.
Examples:
“Which one would you try?”
“Save this for your Thailand trip.”
“Follow ThaiMarketFinds for more Thailand finds.”
“Want us to find this for you? Send us a message.”
